policy: These entries record specific Human Design sources' gate-level biological or hormonal correspondences. They are not established biology, assay interpretation, or evidence that a gate causes, measures, or predicts a hormone. Preserve each source and its wording; do not generalize one source's teaching to all Human Design lineages.

targetConcept.label: Female reproductive system and hormone production

correspondences.claimText: Human Design App's Gate 6 article says Gate 6 is linked to the female reproductive system and hormone production. This is that source's correspondence, not an established physiological association.

sourceCitations.title: Gate 6 Human Design: The Gate of Friction and Emotional Awareness

limitations: This is an attribution to one contemporary Human Design source; it is not a universal or canonical lineage claim.
The cited source does not identify a specific hormone, assay, direction, dose, or validated gate-to-hormone mechanism.
It does not identify an individual's reproductive anatomy, hormone level, fertility, cycle phase, or health state.
